description: Release inputs for the vaccine field-effectiveness scenario. Values as INSP prints them, each with its SitRep locator. No national total. Read by lovs.vaccine_scenario_release.

vaccination_rows_as_printed.source: INSP SitRep 189, section 3.4 (Vaccination): activity continues, no counts printed
INSP SitRep 189, section 3.4 (Vaccination): provincial coverage 99.1 %, no denominator printed

Nord-Kivu.name: frontline_workers
Nord-Kivu.mode_source: ASSUMPTION: Nord-Kivu frontline workers were vaccinated ahead of exposure, as a preventive campaign on a frontline-worker target list (SitReps 158-159); a share vaccinated after exposure would lower their timing share below the pre-exposure value of about 0.93

coverage.numerator_source: INSP SitRep 188, section 2.5: frontline workers (personnel de premiere ligne, PPL) vaccinated, latest printed split
coverage.denominator_source: INSP SitReps 158 and 159: provincial frontline-worker target
coverage.denominator_assumption: ASSUMPTION: the SitRep 158-159 provincial target of 36,070 still describes Nord-Kivu's frontline workforce about 30 releases later, to within 20 % either way; no later SitRep restates or revises it

coverage.source: ASSUMPTION: share of listed contacts whose ring was reached by vaccination (members already ill at vaccination are counted as unprotected in the ring share, not here); SitRep 188 prints 343 cumulative vaccinated contacts and SitRep 189 13,519 contacts under follow-up (2.5 %, not the same population or period)

pre_exposure_weight.source: ASSUMPTION: share vaccinated ahead of exposure; SitReps 186-187 printed a pre-registered group of 3,300 frontline workers, but the SitRep 189 group of 4,428 is not described
ASSUMPTION: make-up of Tshopo's 14,823 vaccinated is not printed (frontline workers, contacts or others)

notes: Nord-Kivu coverage uses the latest printed split of vaccinated frontline workers (SitRep 188); SitRep 189 prints only the combined 4,828, which includes contacts.
Tshopo's 99.1 % equals 14,823 / 14,960, the SitRep 186 target, though SitRep 189 prints no denominator.
A share of all cases averted is reported only for Nord-Kivu, where the vaccinated are split into frontline workers and contacts. Elsewhere the list's make-up is not printed.

Values taken from earlier SitReps (4,027 and 343 from SitRep 188; 3,300 from SitReps 186-187; 14,960 from SitRep 186) are as printed and checked by hand. They are not in a reviewed promotion record, because the SitRep 186-188 promotions do not promote vaccination counts, so the record parity check does not cover them. The 36,070 target is in the reviewed SitRep 158 and 159 records.
